structuredData.headline: Satellite Images: Suspected Scam Compounds Surge in Myanmar
structuredData.description: Recent satellite imagery reveals dozens of suspected scam compounds are being built in remote Myanmar regions, despite government crackdown claims. The rapid construction pace indicates sophisticated criminal logistics and enforcement failures, posing a growing global cybersecurity threat.
